title.zh: 平行世界 Odoo · DSH 工作台

description.en: Read-only Odoo workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Browse CRM, sales, purchase and inventory in a right-side panel, switch companies, and ask the Agent to filter or open records.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里的 Odoo 只读工作台。在右侧查看 CRM、销售、采购和库存，切换公司，也可以让 Agent 筛选或打开记录。
